note: Scam: money by e-transfer before anyone sees the unit.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi, I'm an AI assistant calling for a renter about the apartment at 45 Charles Street East. Is it still available?

turns.speaker: landlord
turns.text: Yes it's available, lots of people are asking. It's 1,800 a month.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Could my client see it this week?

turns.speaker: landlord
turns.text: To hold it you need to send the deposit by e-transfer first. Once you send it I'll set up a viewing.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'll pass that on to my client.
